english.title: Injure a gas fitting / service pipe - Schedule 2B paragraph 10 - Gas Act 1986
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), intentionally or by culpable negligence, injured

(A)_[a gas fitting provided by **(..SPECIFY TRANSPORTER..), a public gas transporter]_
(B)_[a gas fitting provided by **(..SPECIFY SUPPLIER..), a gas supplier]_
(C)_[a service pipe connecting premises at **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..) to the main belonging to **(..SPECIFY OWNER..), a public gas transporter]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 10(1)(a) of Schedule 2B to the Gas Act 1986.
